evidence.title: Macro-Action Topological Navigation under Noisy Localization using Reinforcement Learning

summary: A team of scientists introduced a macro-action based topological navigation framework that mitigates the effects of noisy localization by training policies with reinforcement learning. Benchmark tests demonstrate that the approach outperforms existing navigation techniques in complex, cluttered environments.
title: Researchers develop macro-action topological navigation method robust to noisy localization via reinforcement learning
